trips.route_note: No train service; take a taxi, private driver or shared minibus from Caracas down the autopista to La Guaira, about 30 to 45 minutes each way, then continue to Macuto beach by local taxi.
see: Historic port town centre of La Guaira
Fort San Carlos de la Barra
Local seafood restaurants on the coast
trips.tour_query: La Guaira and Macuto coast day trip from Caracas
trips.why: There is no train, and a taxi or private driver covers the short 30 km road trip down the autopista faster than shared minibuses.
know: No train service; taxi, private driver or shared minibus only.
About 30 to 45 minutes each way from Caracas by road.
Macuto beach is reached by local taxi from La Guaira.

problems: Colonia Tovar: no Omio position, dropped
